MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Reusable cable ties fit my recent Ethernet cables, cable organizers and desk accessories because I can tidy the setup while still rearranging connections.",
    "The microfiber cloth complements my recently purchased blower duster: it helps clean screens while the blower handles loose dust."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HDMI cable and more headphones repeat things I already have without addressing a new need or a problem with my existing equipment.",
    "The hard drive, carrying case and TV mount assume projects or equipment needs that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "The RAM and USB-C audio adapter require compatibility checks and a specific upgrade or connection need that I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been treated as interest in almost any computer upgrade, even though I am mainly organizing and maintaining my setup.",
    "My past cable and headphone purchases seem to have been taken as reasons to buy more of the same, without considering whether those needs are already covered."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent cable ties, headphone mount and blower duster point toward keeping my workspace organized and clean, which makes complementary maintenance items especially relevant.",
    "I need a clear practical purpose for another accessory; owning related equipment alone does not mean I need a replacement, an adapter or an upgrade."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my setup maintenance needs but stretch that interest into unnecessary replacements and unsupported upgrade projects."
}
